biggest_catch: The 15% commission plus your listing discount means you typically net 60-80% of face value — only list here when that beats CardCash's instant offer.
catches: 15% commission is the steepest among major exchanges; a $100 card sold at $90 nets $76.50 — the spread is thin.
Your card may sell in hours or never sell at all; sale timing is not guaranteed.
Extra $1 fee per physical gift card sale (e-gift cards exempt).
$30 fee reported for payout by physical check — use PayPal or ACH instead.
You compete with other sellers on price; undercutting wars shrink your net.

payout_quote: For each gift card sale, Raise.com takes a flat 15% commission of the gift card sale price. They also charge an extra $1 per physical gift card sale (e-gift cards do not have any extra fees). You are only charged a fee when your gift card sells.

repeatable.cadence: Repeatable per card — list again every time you have another unwanted card to sell. You're limited by what you own.

s6.note: 5 concrete steps from signup to payout.

steps: Create a free Raise seller account
Click SELL GIFT CARDS, enter the retailer, card serial number, PIN, and balance
Set your own selling price (list price cannot exceed card value; typical discounts 3-30% off face)
Wait for a buyer; ship physical cards within 3 business days using Raise's prepaid label (Raise covers shipping)
Receive payout by check, PayPal, or direct deposit after the sale completes
timing: Paid after buyer purchase via check, PayPal, or direct deposit; listing itself is free and you only pay fees when the card sells
who_pays: The buyer pays through Raise, and Raise releases your earnings to you via check, PayPal, or direct deposit.
who_qualifies: US sellers 18+. Cards must carry at least a $10–$20 balance, have no expiration dates or balance-draining fees; physical and e-gift cards plus merchandise credit accepted.
work_available: Raise's gift-card marketplace is active and open to new sellers — listing is free and open to anyone meeting the criteria.
what_gets_accepted: Your listing is accepted if the card is a supported brand with a valid, verifiable balance. The card must sell to a buyer — a listing can sit unsold if your price doesn't attract demand.
costs_and_unpaid_time: 15% commission on every sale plus a $1 fee per physical card sold (e-gift cards exempt). Avoid the $30 physical-check payout fee — use PayPal or ACH. Unpaid time goes to listing, pricing research, and competing on price with other sellers.
when_cash_arrives: You're paid after a buyer purchases your card, via check, PayPal, or direct deposit. Listing is free; you only pay fees when the card sells.
